parameter_match_gate.derivation: For fixed d_model=256,n_layers=12,n_heads=8,head_dim=32, changing 2KV to 4KV adds 393216 attention parameters. One d_ff unit changes total parameters by 12*3*256=9216. Exact cancellation requires d_ff(candidate)-d_ff(incumbent)=-393216/9216=-42.6666666667, which is not an integer.

invalidity_reasons: tiny repeated s0 controlled fixture is not representative research corpus evidence
gradient clipping engaged on 100 percent of updates in every paired run
candidate was 3072 parameters smaller than incumbent

unlock_conditions: Resolve strict total-parameter matching without confounding the 2KV-vs-4KV causal contrast, or explicitly preregister a near-match tolerance before execution.
Use one immutable selection-validation corpus/evaluation identity that actually supplies UA, EN and code under the intended real-research-corpus authority boundary.
Compose the accepted D07 first-party cached inference path onto the same source head before training.
Calibrate weak clipping from an unclipped diagnostic and verify clipping is not saturated.
Run at least three paired seeds with identical tokenizer, data trace policy, optimizer, initialization policy and optimized-token budget, then apply RESEARCH-140 without post-hoc threshold changes.
